text:
Diego Ramos: Hey - I lost the emailed ticket/receipt for the 2-leg train from BCN->MAD on 2026-04-12. I only have the PDF boarding pass saved in my phone (no VAT line). Need to expense and the trip was client-facing so would like to claim the full amount. Receipt shows vendor as RailEurope, amount €128.30. Whats the right step?

ExpenseBot: FYI: For VAT reclaim we need an invoice with vendor VAT reg# or a valid receipt that includes VAT details. Boarding passes often lack VAT information. Please upload whatever you have to Concur and tag as "missing VAT". See policy: https://redwood.internal/expenses/vat-policy :page_facing_up:

Maya Chen (Finance): Hi Diego. If the vendor can reissue an invoice with VAT details we can reclaim. Otherwise we can reimburse you but we won't reclaim VAT. Please put the expense in Concur and attach the boarding pass plus any confirmation email. If this was a client-billed expense, note that in the expense item so Billing can pick it up.

Diego Ramos: Uploaded boarding pass and payment confirmation screenshot to Concur (link in expense). Vendor payment ref 0x4c1f2b. Vendor email on payment page is support@raileurope.com.

Oliver Grant: FYI - if this is client-billable, please CC me on the Concur entry and add the client PO number. Billing needs line-level support.

Diego Ramos: Added PO# PO-88977 to the Concur entry and CCed Oliver.

Hannah Park (Manager): Manager approval: approved for reimbursement; client-facing travel. Diego, please confirm amount and that you did not receive any VAT invoice.

Diego Ramos: Confirmed amount €128.30, no VAT invoice received.

Maya Chen (Finance): Thanks. I'll open AP-TICKET-2026-117 to request RailEurope reissue an invoice. If they cannot, we'll process reimbursement to Diego and mark VAT non-reclaimable. AP will also flag this as potential client-billing exception so Billing can decide treatment. Expect update in 2-4 business days.

ExpenseBot: Actions: CONCUR-EXP-3145 (Diego), AP-TICKET-2026-117 (invoice chase). Remember to keep email thread for audit.

Diego Ramos: Appreciate it. If AP needs anything else Ill follow up.
